sentences.text: No: for a UCB, pre-payment charges are not permitted on all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), when the loan is sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026.
This case matches that direction because the loan is floating rate, the borrower is an individual, the purpose is non-business, and the sanction date is 1 March 2026.
The residual policy-based permission for other cases does not apply here because the specific floating-rate non-business individual rule already says no pre-payment charges.
The older pre-payment-charge directions were withdrawn or repealed and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
